## About
Lone Star Park Equine Hospital is a full service equine referral hospital located on the premises of the Lone Star Park Race Track in Grand Prairie, Texas. We work in partnership with referring veterinarians and horse owners to care for performance and pleasure horses.
Our specialty focus is lameness, respiratory, soft tissue and orthopedic surgery, and emergency care. An accurate diagnosis is the first step toward any successful treatment, so we keep an on-site diagnostic laboratory and current diagnostic and surgical equipment.
Our on-site farrier, Kirk Staab, works with our veterinarians to tailor therapeutic treatments to each horse. For ambulatory care and on-site services at equestrian events, you can reach Dr. David Gilchrist directly.

## Services
- Emergency Care: Around the clock care for medical and surgical emergencies, with the hospital staffed 24 hours a day.
- Soundness and pre-purchase exams: Lameness work of every kind, from routine soundness exams to pre-purchase exams.
- Advanced therapeutic treatments: Extracorporeal shockwave therapy, cold laser therapy and acupuncture, along with platelet rich plasma (PRP) and routine therapies for equine athletes.
- Diagnostic Services: Olympus video endoscopy, digital radiology, digital ultrasound, an Equine Infectious Anemia (EIA) lab, CBC, chemistry, blood gas analysis, foal IgG snap tests and electrolyte panels.
- Dental care: All of our dental care is provided by veterinarians.
- Surgery: Colic surgery, orthopedic and soft tissue procedures, including arthroscopy and throat surgeries.
- Farrier Services: Our doctors, radiology equipment and farrier Kirk Staab work together to tailor therapies to the individual horse.
- Ambulatory Services: Ambulatory care and on-site services at equestrian events. Contact Dr. David Gilchrist directly by phone or text.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring my horse in after hours?
A: Yes. Emergency services are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Q: Where is the hospital?
A: We are on the premises of the Lone Star Park Race Track on Performance Place in Grand Prairie.

Q: Do you work with my regular veterinarian?
A: Yes. We are a referral hospital and work in partnership with referring veterinarians and horse owners.
